herramientas.title: CYBERSECURITY_TOOLS
herramientas.description: Access the professional-grade security suite. Each module is optimized for deep analysis and defensive verification.

ai_threat_detector.desc: Detect AI-generated malicious code and suspicious patterns.

code_analyzer.desc: Deep code analysis for vulnerabilities and exploits.

site_auditor.desc: Analyze security headers, SSL, and vulnerabilities.

port_scanner.desc: Scan for open ports on remote servers.

dns_lookup.desc: Retrieve detailed DNS records (A, MX, TXT).

ip_intel.desc: Geolocation and ISP data for any IP address.

entropy_auditor.desc: Calculate cryptographic entropy and estimated brute-force resistance.

password_generator.desc: Generate cryptographically secure passwords with custom entropy rules.

metadata.desc: Extract hidden GPS, device, and EXIF metadata from digital media.

steganography.desc: Conceal encrypted data within visual carriers using LSB techniques.

phishing.desc: Deep analysis of URIs for deceptive patterns and phishing clusters.

sqli.desc: Advanced automated scanner for SQL injection vulnerabilities and fuzzing.

browser_auditor.desc: Analyze browser fingerprinting and privacy leaks.

headers.desc: Inspect HTTP headers and security policies.

data_leak.desc: Check if your email has been exposed in massive data breaches.

honeypot.desc: Monitor intrusion attempts in real-time using deception traps.

subdomain_recon.desc: Map attack surfaces by enumerating subdomains and hidden assets.

hash_cracker.desc: Identify and reverse MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256 cryptographic hashes.

jwt_audit.desc: Decode and analyze vulnerabilities in JSON Web Tokens (JWT).

payload_lab.desc: Advanced exploit payload generator with obfuscation techniques.

threat_intel.desc: Global attack heatmap and real-time threat intelligence feed.

cve_oracle.desc: Instant lookup for CVE vulnerability database and risk scores.

cloud_sentry.desc: Audit cloud infrastructure security (S3, IAM, Azure, GCP).

bin_analyst.desc: Static binary forensics and malware detection analyzer.

osint_searcher.desc: Locate public info and digital footprint by name or alias.

dark_web_monitor.desc: Detect stolen accounts and data leaks in the Dark Web.

geo_tracker.desc: Advanced geographic tracker via IP and triangulation.

recovery_protocol.desc: Tactical assistant for recovering stolen accounts and sites.

account_resurrect.desc: Deep protocols for reviving stolen Meta, Google, and Microsoft accounts.

attacker_intercept.desc: Retaliation module: Intercept attacker data using tactical deceivers.

session_sanitizer.desc: Force mass session logout and purge malicious tokens in the cloud.

forensic_report.desc: Legal evidence generator and intrusion traces for abuse reporting.

home.hero_desc: A complete suite of professional-grade tools for security auditing, forensic analysis, and defensive intelligence. Built for researchers, developers, and ethical hackers.
